module: ImGui widget library of the Dynamic Decals tool. draw() displays a property (name, description tooltip, optional widget type choice) then the widget suited to its type: bool (checkbox), int (Input/Slider/Drag/Combo), float (Input/Slider/Drag), Point2F (Input/Slider/Drag), Point3F and Point4F (Slider/Color), string (Input/InputMultiline), Texture (File/ImageButton), File, ColorI and MultiColor (gradient). The properties come from the dynamicDecals API (api.propertiesMap, api.types, api.widgetTypes). Also handles the temporary highlighting of a property with automatic scrolling.
notes: An unknown property type is displayed in red with the property name.
Most widgets offer a reset-to-default button (refresh icon) if property.default is defined; the new value is written to property.value.
If property.widgetType is absent, the default widget of the type is used. If api.widgetTypes[type] exists, a "Widget Type" button opens a popup to change property.widgetType.
In the tool's debug mode (preference dynamicDecalsTool.general.debug), the tooltip adds the widget identifier.
Registered preferences: texturePreviewSize (float, 128, 32 to 512) and multiColorWidgetWidth (float, 128, 32 to 512).

draw.desc: Draws a property and its widget. Returns true if the value was modified this frame; editEnded[0] is updated to indicate the end of an edit (mouse release, validation).

value.desc: Current value of the property (type according to property.type)

property.desc: Property {id, name?, description?, type?, widgetType?, default?, value, ...}; id is used to find api.propertiesMap

guiId.desc: imgui identifier suffix to make the widget unique (widgetId = "##guiId_property.id")

editEnded.desc: imgui boolean pointer ([0]) set to true at the end of the edit

widgetOptions.desc: Rendering options, for example widthMod (width adjustment in pixels)

defaultButton.desc: Draws a "refresh" icon button followed by SameLine; calls cbFunc on click.

highlight.desc: Highlights a property (frame in the BeamNG color) and scrolls the window to it. Replaces any previous highlight.

id.desc: Full widget identifier, in the format "##guiId_propertyId"

setup.desc: Initializes with the parent tool, gets the dynamicDecals API and the helper, and registers the update that expires the highlights.

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Registers the preferences texturePreviewSize and multiColorWidgetWidth.
